label: Relations
program:
% append/3 runs forwards and backwards.
app([], L, L).
app([H|T], L, [H|R]) :- app(T, L, R).

label: Tabling
program:
% Left recursion terminates once path/2 is tabled.
:- use_module(library(tabling)).
:- table path/2.

path(X, Y) :- path(X, Z), edge(Z, Y).
path(X, Y) :- edge(X, Y).

edge(a, b). edge(b, c). edge(c, a).

label: Bignums
program:
% Integers and rationals are unbounded.
fact(0, 1) :- !.
fact(N, F) :- N1 is N - 1, fact(N1, F1), F is N * F1.

label: Grammars
program:
% A DCG over the chars of a double-quoted string.
number(N) --> digits(Ds), { number_chars(N, Ds) }.

digits([D|T]) --> digit(D), digits(T).
digits([D]) --> digit(D).

digit(D) --> [D], { member(D, "0123456789") }.

sum(S) --> number(N), "+", sum(S0), { S is N + S0 }.
sum(N) --> number(N).

label: Constraints
program:
:- use_module(library(clpz)).

% SEND + MORE = MONEY
puzzle([S,E,N,D] + [M,O,R,E] = [M,O,N,E,Y]) :-
    Vars = [S,E,N,D,M,O,R,Y],
    Vars ins 0..9,
    all_different(Vars),
              S*1000 + E*100 + N*10 + D
            + M*1000 + O*100 + R*10 + E
    #= M*10000 + O*1000 + N*100 + E*10 + Y,
    M #\= 0, S #\= 0,
    label(Vars).

label: Coroutining
program:
:- use_module(library(dif)).
:- use_module(library(freeze)).

% dif/2 waits until it can decide; freeze/2 waits for a binding.
query: dif(X, 3), freeze(X, Y is X * X), member(X, [1,2,3,4])

label: Output
program: row(N) :- S is N*N, C is N*N*N, format("~t~d~4|~t~d~10|~t~d~18|~n", [N, S, C]).
